title: Personal Checking Service Charge Basis Note
content:
Service charges on a Personal Checking account are assessed at the tier in force on the day of the service.

1. An outgoing domestic wire incurs the tier's domestic wire charge and an outgoing international wire the tier's international wire charge, each recorded against the wire debit.
2. An incoming wire credit incurs the tier's incoming wire charge.
3. An official check purchased from the account incurs the tier's official check charge.
4. A stop payment order or renewal incurs the tier's stop payment charge, recorded against the order, except that the first orders and renewals placed in a statement cycle up to the tier's free allowance, counted in order of the date each was placed, are free.
5. A replacement debit card incurs the tier's standard replacement charge when the reason is lost or damaged, and no standard charge when the reason is stolen, compromised or expired. Rush delivery additionally incurs the tier's rush charge whatever the reason.
6. Account research requested by the customer incurs the tier's hourly research charge per started hour, with a one-hour minimum. Research needed to investigate a bank error or a claim is never charged.
7. A tier charge of 0.00 writes nothing.
8. Service charges are not subject to the daily count that limits overdraft-item and returned-item charges.

**Condition and result for a replacement card.**

| Reason for replacement | Delivery | Charges arising |
|---|---|---|
| Lost or damaged | Standard | The tier's standard replacement charge |
| Lost or damaged | Rush | The tier's standard replacement charge and the tier's rush charge |
| Stolen, compromised or expired | Standard | None |
| Stolen, compromised or expired | Rush | The tier's rush charge alone |

**Worked illustration of research time (hypothetical).** Research occupying 2 hours and 10 minutes is charged as 3 started hours at the tier's hourly rate. Research occupying 15 minutes is charged as the one-hour minimum.
